_comment: Proposed entry for the color_palettes block of the MLA registry. Merge into mla_registry (next version) after review. Web values match docs/assets/css/site.css.
name: Barnes PLLC identity layer on MLA
does_not_apply_to: formal legal documents (Times New Roman, black)

zones.firm: Client-facing pages. Charcoal grounds, gold accent, warm light surfaces.
zones.lab: Insights, newsletter, practice tools. MLA autumnal palette unchanged.

tokens.role: Header, hero, footer ground (matches business card and signature tile)
Wordmark bar only. Never used in UI. Signature tile renders it as #1F6FD1.
MLA Ochre. Accent on dark, button fill
MLA Bark. Lab headings and text
MLA Deep Ochre. Decorative only on parchment (4.43:1 fails small text)
MLA Teal. Lab eyebrows, buttons, live status
MLA Rust. Lab links, emphasis, in-development status

typography.labels: DM Sans 600, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.18em (echoes business card capitals)
typography.wordmark: Supplied artwork only (barnes-logo-white.png, barnes-logo-dark.png). Do not retype in a font.
typography.office_documents: Unchanged: Style Guide v3.2 (Constantia / Calibri Light / Calibri)

textures.texture-dark.webp: Firm hero, CTA band, social image. Derived from the card's geometric surface.
textures.texture-gold.webp: Lab hero and Lab band, under an 86 to 90 percent parchment overlay.
